Andre Drummond shares the advice he would give every rookie entering the league today.

From expectations to staying disciplined, working hard, and understanding your value, Andre opens up about the lessons he’s learned throughout his career. This is an honest conversation about growth, mistakes, perseverance, and what it really takes to last in professional basketball.

Whether you’re an athlete, a basketball fan, or chasing your own goals, there’s something to learn from Andre’s journey.

🎥 Interview by JayxLamar
